entries.reason: the function arrived in iOS 16, and iOS 6 has nothing that answers it; the port computes the components from the matrix the way the release does, measured on the host: the sign of the determinant carries a flip into the x scale, the y scale is not negative, and the rotation is the angle of the first row, turned a half circle where the flip is
entries.effect: the components the release answers for every transform the host test holds (tests/backports/host/affine-components, 28 transforms); the one case not matched is a singular transform with two non-zero rows, where the host's shear is a rounding artefact of about 1e16 and the port answers zero shear and a zero y scale, so the port's rebuilt matrix loses that row
entries.source: CoreGraphics of the SDK 26.2 host (macOS 27), measured through tests/backports/host/affine-components; the SDK declaration in CGAffineTransform.h
